name: HalocarbonChemistry
description:
Calculates the concentrations, effective radiative forcing (ERF) and equivalent effective
stratospheric chlorine (EESC) of the F-gases and Montreal Protocol gases, following MAGICC7.

The species come from the `fgases` and `montreal_gases` parameters, and `{species}` below
stands for each of them.
Their defaults are the 23 F-gases and 18 Montreal Protocol gases of MAGICC7 v7.5.3
(its `FGAS_*` and `MHALO_*` configuration), so by default the component declares about 128 variables.

# Inputs

- `Emissions|{species}` (kt {species}/yr): emissions of each species over the step
- `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|{species}` (ppt): prescribed concentration of each F-gas
  with the `fgas_switch_year` parameter,
  and of each Montreal Protocol gas with `montreal_gases_switch_year`
- `Lifetime|CH4|OH` (yr), only with the `include_variable_oh_lifetime` parameter: scales the OH lifetimes
- `Surface Air Temperature Change` (K), only with the `include_variable_stratospheric_lifetime` parameter:
  shortens the stratospheric lifetimes
- `Emissions|CO2|Fossil` (GtC/yr), only with the `fgas_regions` parameter:
  spreads short-lived F-gases between the hemispheres,
  with each year after `last_split_year` split like that year

# States

- `Atmospheric Concentrations|{species}` (ppt): concentration of each species at the end of the step

# Outputs

- `Effective Radiative Forcing|F-Gases` (W/m^2): total F-gas ERF,
  on the four-box grid with the `fgas_regions` parameter
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Montreal Protocol Halogen Gases` (W/m^2): total Montreal Protocol gas ERF
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|F-Gases|{species}` (W/m^2): ERF of each F-gas,
  on the four-box grid with the `fgas_regions` parameter
- `Effective Radiative Forcing|Montreal Protocol Halogen Gases|{species}` (W/m^2):
  ERF of each Montreal Protocol gas
- `Equivalent Effective Stratospheric Chlorine` (ppt):
  EESC from the chlorine and bromine of every species,
  from concentrations `stratospheric_delay` years earlier

# Lifetimes

$$\frac{1}{\tau} = \frac{1}{s_{OH} \tau_{OH}} + \frac{1}{s_{strat} \tau_{strat}} + \frac{1}{\tau_{other}}$$

where $s_{OH}$ is the CH4 OH lifetime relative to its unperturbed value and
$s_{strat} = 1 / (1 + f \cdot k \cdot \max(0, T - T_{1980}))$ after 1980.

# Concentrations

Species with lifetimes of at least 5 years are integrated with Crank-Nicolson.
Shorter-lived species use the exact exponential solution.
Both use the emissions and lifetime at the start of the year.

parameters.name: fgases
parameters.description:
F-gases, which do not deplete ozone.

The default is MAGICC7's 23 `FGAS_*` species.

parameters.name: montreal_gases
parameters.description:
Montreal Protocol gases.

The default is MAGICC7's 18 `MHALO_*` species.

parameters.name: br_cl_ratio
parameters.description:
Ozone depletion by bromine relative to chlorine (MAGICC7 `STRATOZ_BR_VS_CL_SCALE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: cfc11_release_factor
parameters.description:
EESC scaling, the CFC-11 release factor (MAGICC7 `MHALO_RELEASEFACTORC11`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: stratospheric_delay
parameters.description:
Time from the troposphere to the stratosphere (MAGICC7 `GEN_EESC_STRATMIXDELAY`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: air_molar_mass
parameters.description:
Molar mass of air (MAGICC7 `GEN_AIR_GRAMMPROMOL`)

unit: g/mol

parameters.name: atmosphere_mass
parameters.description:
Mass of the atmosphere (MAGICC7 `GEN_ATM_TOTMASS_1E21GRAMM`)

unit: 1e21 g

parameters.name: include_variable_oh_lifetime
parameters.description: Scale OH lifetimes with the CH4 OH lifetime (MAGICC7 `*_USE_TAUOH_VAR`)

parameters.name: initial_ch4_oh_lifetime
parameters.description:
Unperturbed CH4 OH lifetime, the reference for the OH scaling.

unit: yr

MAGICC7 derives it from `CH4_TAUTOT_INIT` and the other CH4 lifetimes.

parameters.name: meridional_flux_reference_year
parameters.description:
Year from which warming speeds up the meridional circulation (MAGICC7 `GEN_CHANGE_MERIDIONALFLUX_YR`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: meridional_flux_change_per_degree
parameters.description:
Change in meridional flux per degree of warming (MAGICC7 `GEN_MERIDFLUX_CHNGPERDEG`)

unit: K^-1

parameters.name: stratospheric_lifetime_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Sensitivity of stratospheric lifetimes to the meridional flux (MAGICC7 `*_TAUSTRAT_SENS2MERIDFLUX`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: fgas_switch_year
parameters.description:
Last year of F-gas concentrations prescribed by `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|{species}`
(MAGICC7 `FGAS_SWITCHFROMCONC2EMIS_YEAR`).

unit: yr

`None` calculates them from emissions throughout.

parameters.name: montreal_gases_switch_year
parameters.description:
As `fgas_switch_year`, for the Montreal Protocol gases (MAGICC7 `MHALO_SWITCHFROMCONC2EMIS_YEAR`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: fgas_forcing_scale
parameters.description:
Scale on the ERF of every F-gas (MAGICC7 `RF_FGASSUM_SCALE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: montreal_gases_forcing_scale
parameters.description:
Scale on the ERF of every Montreal Protocol gas (MAGICC7 `RF_MHALOSUM_SCALE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: fgas_regions
parameters.description:
Regional pattern of F-gas ERF.

Setting it makes `Effective Radiative Forcing|F-Gases` and each F-gas ERF four-box outputs.
